name: Main Menu
blurb: This program lists all application launchers that are installed on your system.
description:
This program lists all application launchers that are installed on your system. You can then use a clean, modern, and intuitive interface to customize the main menu to your liking.

The following features are included:

• set launcher-icons to a specific file or icon-name

• search through icons of your installed icon-theme

• add and remove search-keywords

• make launchers execute a specific file or command

• set working directory for the execution

• convert weblinks into valid commands

• change launcher names and comments

• create, edit, and remove launcher-actions

• show or hide launchers in the main menu

• show or hide launchers in certain desktop environments

• change the launcher's menu-categories

• enable or disable launcher's startup-animations

• show a terminal-window when executing launchers

• use a more powerful GPU for certain launchers

• change advanced settings with your default text-editor

• reset launchers back to their original states

• create and delete custom launchers

• use search to find your launchers in the sidebar

• show hidden launchers in the sidebar

• create duplicates of launchers

• open .desktop files through the app-menu, the file-manager, or via drag-and-drop

• install .desktop files to the desktop-environment's application menu

• export .desktop files to custom locations

• open locations of launcher's .desktop files in file-manager

• use the application on any freedesktop.org compliant desktop-environment

• use the application on small-screen devices

• navigate the interface with your keyboard

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
